title: List Page - Verify the content on Column Configuration – List Page.
preconditions:
1.URL must be working
2.user should be on FMS home page

steps.action: Go to Extraction & Load Layer -> Column Configuration
steps.expectedResult: User should redirect to the list page

steps.action: Observe the content on list page
steps.expectedResult:
Grid Columns: 
1.Sr No
2.Column Name  
3.Column Type 
4.Column Data Type 
5.Created On 
6.Created By 
7.Modified On  
8.Modified By 

----------------------------------

Buttons
-Add 
-Delete 
-Export 
-Import 
-Search Panel
-Refresh
-Column Settings
